recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Future changes to operation invocation wording should be handled under FHIR-33385 or later operations-page trackers rather than reopening FHIR-37983.
issue_request: FHIR-37983 was a Published FHIR-core/FHIR-I change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification for R5. It raised two operation concerns: the operation request wording around resource-body POSTs with URL parameters, and the Resource $convert OperationDefinition using input/output parameter names. The final resolution said the first item was handled by an existing tracker and that $convert input/output would change to resource/return.
initial_application: Commit 9e674a5673258f1ba4d808d2c5967ce3d7a00849, merged through HL7/fhir PR #2271 on 2022-08-29, directly applied FHIR-37983 by changing source/resource/operationdefinition-Resource-convert.xml from input/output to resource/return and updating the related description, comment, and footer prose.
additional_context: FHIR-33385 is the existing tracker for the first bullet. It was Published for R5 and implemented in source/operations.html by commit f142c025b4ce2f551ca9376d48b3dfa12287d9d4, replacing the old 'no parameters on the url' wording with POST resource-body plus additional query-parameter language. FHIR-I minutes from 2022-08-29 record the same split: the first item was duplicated by another tracker and FHIR-37983 would change the convert operation names.
reconciliation: No source change was needed. The active Resource source includes the Resource operations list, which references OperationDefinition/Resource-convert, and the current authoritative $convert OperationDefinition already names the input parameter resource and the output parameter return.

related_jiras.note: Published tracker that handled the resource-body POST plus URL/query-parameter clarification explicitly deferred by FHIR-37983.
